title: Polaris Vibe Spec — graph.json
description: Hand-editable spec graph: source of truth for the spec/ Markdown view and the impact-traversal CLI. Validate with: ajv -s .polaris/graph.schema.json -d .polaris/graph.json — or wire it up in your editor (VS Code: 'json.schemas' setting).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file so editors auto-validate without extra config.

version.description: Schema version. Currently always 1; bumped only on a breaking layout change.

nodes.description: Map of node id → SpecNode. Keys must equal the node's `id` field.

id.description: Stable, deterministic, never reassigned. Format: <PREFIX>-<DOMAIN>-<SLUG-OR-NUMBER>. PREFIX: REQ|API|WF|ENT.

type.description: Node type. Determines the prefix in `id`: requirement→REQ, api→API, workflow→WF, entity→ENT.

domain.description: Uppercase domain bucket (AUTH, BILLING, ORDER, NOTIF, USER, GENERAL, …). Becomes the middle segment of `id`.

title.description: Short human-readable name. Editable via spec/<id>.md → `pv promote`.

description.description: Free-form prose. Empty string is allowed (= deliberately cleared). Editable via spec/<id>.md → `pv promote`.

tags.description: Search/grouping tags. Editable via spec/<id>.md → `pv promote`.

relations.description: Outgoing typed edges. Add via `pv link`; never edit `target` to a non-existent id (caught by `pv validate`).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp set at mint time. Immutable — `pv promote` rejects edits.

type.description: Relation semantics drive impact traversal direction. depends_on/implements/uses → reverse (impact follows incoming edges). affects → forward (declared downstream effect).

target.description: Id of the target node. Must exist in `nodes`; `pv validate` flags dangling targets.
